tools.name: google_ads_propose_update_campaigns
tools.description:
Propose changes to one or more Google Ads campaigns. This tool will:
1. Create one pending operation per array item
2. Show each operation as a separate approval row in the UI
3. Wait for user to approve/reject each item independently (up to max(2.5 min, 1 min per op))
4. Auto-execute approved operations and return combined results

IMPORTANT: Create one separate campaigns array entry per type of change so the user can approve/reject each independently. However, if you have multiple changes to the SAME campaign, bundle them into a single campaigns array entry with one new_state object containing all changed fields. Splitting the same campaign into multiple entries causes batch execution conflicts.

The operation_id field is automatically injected — do not generate it yourself.

CRITICAL — Currency: Before proposing any budget or bid change, call google_ads_get_currency for this customer_id
and pass the returned currency_code (e.g. INR, USD) into this tool. The tool needs this to convert amounts correctly.

CRITICAL — Budget values: Pass ALL budget and bid amounts in ACCOUNT CURRENCY (human-readable).
Pass 50 for $50 or 300 for ₹300. Do NOT convert to micros — the tool handles that internally.
Values from GAQL queries (e.g. campaign_budget.amount_micros = 50000000) must be divided by 1,000,000 before passing
(50000000 / 1000000 = 50.0). Similarly for bidding targets: target_cpa_micros from GAQL → divide by 1,000,000.

CRITICAL: current_state should only contain entity-level properties (name, status, budget_micros, bidding_strategy, network_settings, etc.). Do NOT put action arrays (location_changes, language_changes, etc.) in current_state — those are actions, not state. Only put them in new_state.

Supported fields in new_state:
- name: Campaign name
- status: ENABLED, PAUSED, or REMOVED
- budget_micros: Daily budget in account currency (e.g. 50 for $50, 300 for ₹300). Tool converts to micros internally.
- budget_id: Budget resource ID to link
- start_date: YYYY-MM-DD format
- end_date: YYYY-MM-DD format
- bidding_strategy: { type, target_cpa_micros?, target_roas?, target_cpv_micros?, target_spend_micros? }
  Supported types: MANUAL_CPC, TARGET_CPA, TARGET_ROAS, MAXIMIZE_CONVERSIONS, MAXIMIZE_CONVERSION_VALUE, MANUAL_CPV, TARGET_CPV, TARGET_SPEND
  For MAXIMIZE_CONVERSIONS: pass target_cpa_micros in account currency (e.g. 10 for $10 CPA). For MAXIMIZE_CONVERSION_VALUE: pass target_roas as decimal (e.g. 3.5 for 350% ROAS).
- network_settings: { target_google_search?, target_search_network?, target_content_network?, target_partner_search_network? }
- ad_serving_optimization_status: OPTIMIZE | ROTATE | ROTATE_INDEFINITELY
- frequency_caps: Array of { level, event_type, time_unit, time_length, cap }
- location_changes: Array of { action: ADD|REMOVE, geo_target_constant, location_name?, negative?, criterion_id? (required for REMOVE) }
- negative_keyword_list_changes: Array of { action: ATTACH|DETACH, shared_set_id, shared_set_name? }
- negative_keyword_changes: Array of { action: ADD|REMOVE, text, match_type, criterion_id? } — campaign-level negative keywords (CampaignCriterion with negative=true). REMOVE requires criterion_id.
- content_exclusion_changes: Array of { action: ADD|REMOVE, content_label_type, criterion_id? (required for REMOVE) }
- language_changes: Array of { action: ADD|REMOVE, language_constant: "languageConstants/1000", language_name?, criterion_id? (required for REMOVE) }
- conversion_goal_changes: Array of { category: string, origin: string, biddable: boolean } (e.g. category=PURCHASE, origin=WEBSITE)
- app_optimization_goal: INSTALL | IN_APP_ACTION | IN_APP_VALUE

budget_micros.description: In account currency (e.g. 50 for $50). Divide GAQL amount_micros by 1,000,000.

current_state.description: Current campaign state (only entity-level fields — do NOT include action arrays like location_changes here). budget_micros should be in account currency (divide GAQL micros by 1,000,000).

budget_micros.description: In account currency (e.g. 50 for $50, 300 for ₹300). Tool converts to micros.

target_cpa_micros.description: Target CPA in account currency (e.g. 10 for $10). Tool converts to micros. Used by TARGET_CPA and optionally by MAXIMIZE_CONVERSIONS.

target_roas.description: Target ROAS as decimal e.g. 3.5 = 350%. Used by TARGET_ROAS and optionally by MAXIMIZE_CONVERSION_VALUE.

target_cpv_micros.description: Target CPV in account currency (e.g. 0.05 for $0.05). Tool converts to micros (for TARGET_CPV).

target_spend_micros.description: CPC bid ceiling in account currency. Tool converts to micros (for TARGET_SPEND).

enhanced_cpc_enabled.description: Enable enhanced CPC (for MANUAL_CPC, default false)

bidding_strategy.description: Bidding strategy to apply. For MAXIMIZE_CONVERSIONS: pass target_cpa_micros to set a CPA target (or omit to let Google optimize freely). For MAXIMIZE_CONVERSION_VALUE: pass target_roas to set a ROAS target. The Google Ads UI label "Maximize Clicks" maps to the API enum TARGET_SPEND — both values are accepted; MAXIMIZE_CLICKS is normalized to TARGET_SPEND at execute time.

text.description: Keyword text (≤80 chars; do NOT wrap in quotes/brackets).

criterion_id.description: Required for REMOVE — the campaign criterion ID.

negative_keyword_changes.description: Campaign-level negative keyword changes (CampaignCriterion with negative=true). Distinct from negative_keyword_list_changes (which attaches/detaches SharedSet negative-keyword LISTS). Anchor: google-ads-python v24 examples/targeting/add_campaign_targeting_criteria.py:108-131.

criterion_id.description: Required for REMOVE — the campaign criterion ID

category.description: e.g. PURCHASE, LEAD, SIGNUP, PAGE_VIEW, DOWNLOAD, PHONE_CALL, OTHER

origin.description: ConversionOrigin enum: WEBSITE, APP, CALL_FROM_ADS, STORE, GOOGLE_HOSTED, YOUTUBE_HOSTED

biddable.description: true to optimize for this goal, false to exclude it

conversion_goal_changes.description: Campaign conversion goal biddability changes (post-launch). Sets which goals are biddable for this campaign.

new_state.description: Desired new state (only fields to update). All budget/bid amounts in account currency (not micros).

campaigns.description: Array of campaign updates to propose

currency_code.description: REQUIRED. Account currency from google_ads_get_currency (e.g. INR, USD). Required so the tool can convert human-readable amounts to micros and display the correct currency symbol.

mode.description: Two-call flow control. Pass mode='dryrun' (default) on the first call — server persists and validates the operations without making any platform changes, and returns operation_ids + account_id. Confirm with the user; if they approve, call this tool again with ONLY mode='live', operation_ids set to the subset they approved, and account_id from the dryrun response — do NOT resend the entity fields.

operation_ids.description: Required when mode='live'. Array of operation_ids returned by a prior mode='dryrun' call. Pass only the subset the user approved.

SELECT campaign.id, campaign.name, campaign.status, campaign.advertising_channel_type,
  metrics.impressions, metrics.clicks, metrics.ctr, metrics.cost_micros,
  metrics.average_cpc, metrics.conversions, metrics.cost_per_conversion,
  metrics.conversions_from_interactions_rate, metrics.search_impression_share
FROM campaign
WHERE campaign.advertising_channel_type = 'SEARCH'
  AND campaign.status = 'ENABLED'
  AND segments.date DURING LAST_30_DAYS
